fullPoolMethod: Original trained Top 150 retained; ranks 151–1000 extended by period-specific positional-frequency prior.

sourceMonthResearch.principle: Track the month/year of the winning number's previous appearance. Penalize recently revisited source regions and restore weight as the learned return interval approaches.
sourceMonthResearch.guardrail: Month/source-region factor is capped because 2025 ablation did not show consistent improvement for both draw periods.

smartReduction.objective: Minimize candidate count while preserving measured hit coverage.
smartReduction.guardrail: Auto never claims predictive certainty. It only recommends a cutoff from locked historical results.

predictionReductionUI.note: Recommendation is derived from the locked backtest stored in the app.
